blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed as multi-agent systems rather than as a standalone model operating within a single context. Recent agent harnesses allow the model to instantiate worker agents and to author the executable workflow that coordinates them, shifting the design of system structure from developers to the model at run time. The quality of this organization therefore constitutes a distinct capability, yet existing benchmarks either measure end-to-end task completion or evaluate coordination under structures specified in advance. We formalize this capability as workflow orchestration and introduce WorkflowArena, a benchmark of 145 long-horizon tasks spanning 8 professional domains, from software engineering and formal mathematics to legal analysis and 3D production. Each task specifies an initial workspace and an integrated deliverable composed of interdependent components, which is assessed by a hidden verifier. Agents determine autonomously whether and how to delegate, and all delegation is recorded, enabling joint evaluation of deliverable quality and the organization of the underlying work. Experiments with nine models show that no single configuration performs best across all domains and that systems exhibit distinct delegation strategies: at high effort, Claude models in Claude Code invoke workflows less frequently but with larger worker groups, whereas GPT models in Codex delegate more frequently in smaller units. When the executing model is held fixed on a challenging subset of tasks, workflows authored by Claude Opus 5.5 substantially improve weaker executors, indicating that workflow organization is itself a measurable determinant of task performance.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型代理越来越多地作为多代理系统而不是在单一背景下运行的独立模型被部署. 近期的代理牵引使模型能够即时化工人代理,并编写协调他们的可执行工作流程,将系统结构的设计从开发者转移到运行时间的模型. 因此,本组织的质量是独特的能力,但现有的基准要么衡量最终任务完成情况,要么在事先指定的结构下评价协调情况。 我们把这种能力正规化为工作流程的管弦乐,并引入了WorkflowArena,这是跨越8个专业领域的145个长视野任务的基准,从软件工程和正规数学到法律分析和3D制作. 每项任务都规定一个初始工作空间和一个由相互依存部分组成的综合交付品,由隐藏核查员评估。 代理人自主确定是否和如何授权,并记录所有授权,以便能够联合评价交付品质量和基本工作安排。 使用9个模型的实验表明,没有一个单一的配置在所有领域都表现得最好,而且系统表现出不同的授权战略: Claude Code中的克洛德模型引用工作流程的次数较少,但使用较大的工人群体,而Codex中的GPT模型则更频繁地在更小的单位中进行代理. 当执行模式被固定在一个具有挑战性的任务子集上时,由克洛德·奥普斯·5.5所撰写的工作流程大大改进了较弱的执行者,表明工作流程组织本身是任务绩效的可衡量决定因素.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models have evolved from text generators into agents that act in external environments and pursue goals over long horizons [ 1 , 2 , 3 ] . As tasks grow longer, the limiting factor shifts from what a single agent can accomplish to how the work is organized. Long-horizon tasks consist of interdependent subtasks that call for different expertise and independent verification, and a single context that must retain the entire history of such work soon becomes a bottleneck. Further progress therefore depends on system intelligence , the ability of an agent system to organize multiple intelligent components into a coherent and adaptive whole [ 4 ] . Current systems already delegate and replan dynamically [ 5 ] , and recent harnesses allow the model to author the executable workflow that coordinates its workers [ 6 , 7 ] . The structure of a multi-agent system, once fixed by its developers, is thus increasingly determined by the model at run time, and its quality becomes a property of the model that requires evaluation in its own right.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型已经从文本生成器演变为在外部环境中发挥作用并追求远近目标[1,2,3]的代理人. 随着任务的延长,限制因素从单一代理人能够完成的工作转移到如何组织工作。 长期任务包括需要不同专门知识和独立核查的相互依存的次级任务,必须保留这项工作的全部历史的单一背景很快成为瓶颈。 因此,进一步的进展取决于系统智能,即一个代理系统将多种智能组件组织成一个连贯和适应性整体的能力[4]。 目前的系统已经动态地授权和重新规划[5],而最近的利用使得模型能够编写协调工人的可执行工作流程[6,7]。 多代理系统的结构一旦由它的开发者固定,在运行时间就越来越多地由模型决定,其质量也成为模型的属性,需要自己进行评价.

blocks.en: We refer to this capability as workflow orchestration . A workflow is an executable specification of how a task is partitioned among agents, which context each agent receives, and how intermediate results are verified and integrated. These decisions shape system behavior beyond the control of any individual agent. Running independent units in parallel, for instance, shortens the critical path but adds coordination cost, whereas an explicit verification point can catch an error before it propagates to downstream work [ 8 , 9 , 6 ] . The appropriate organization depends on the dependency structure of the task and on the available budget. Because the same agents can succeed or fail depending on how their work is organized, a premise we test directly in § 4.5 , orchestration is a system-level capability rather than an implementation detail. This leaves a central question that current evaluations do not answer:
blocks.zh: 我们将此能力称为工作流程协调。 一个工作流程是一个可执行的规格,说明一个任务如何在代理人之间分配,每个代理人得到什么背景,中间结果如何得到核实和整合。 这些决定塑造的系统行为超出了任何个体代理人的控制范围. 例如,平行运行的独立单位缩短了关键路径,但增加了协调费用,而明确的核查点在向下游工作推广[8、9、6]之前可能会发现错误。 适当的组织取决于任务的依赖结构和现有预算。 由于同样的代理人可以成功或失败,取决于他们的工作如何组织,我们在第4.5节中直接测试的前提,管弦乐是一种系统层面的能力,而不是执行细节. 这就留下了一个核心问题,即目前的评价没有回答:

blocks.en: To what extent can LLM agents autonomously orchestrate multi-agent workflows to accomplish realistic long-horizon tasks?
blocks.zh: LLM代理能够在多大程度上自主地协调多代理工作流程,完成现实的长视距任务?

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks address parts of this question. End-to-end agent benchmarks measure task completion in realistic environments, including long-horizon and compositional work [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 , 15 ] , but they treat the agent as a single unit, so how its work is divided remains invisible. Multi-agent benchmarks study collaboration under predefined coordination protocols or among independently tasked agents [ 16 , 17 ] ; the structure under evaluation is chosen by the benchmark designer rather than by the model. Workflow benchmarks evaluate generated plans and workflow structures [ 18 , 19 , 20 ] , typically offline or in simulation, so the decisions they score never play out on real artifacts. None of them observes a workflow that the model writes itself and then adapts as its workers report back on real work.
blocks.zh: 现有基准涉及这一问题的部分内容。 端对端代理基准在现实环境下衡量任务完成情况,包括长视野和组成工作[10,11,12,13,14,15],但它们将代理作为单一单位处理,因此其工作如何划分仍然看不见. 多代理人基准研究根据预先确定的协调协议或独立任务代理人[16,17]进行协作;评价的结构由基准设计者而不是模型选择. 工作流程基准评价生成的计划和工作流程结构[18,19,20],一般是离线或模拟,因此它们得分的决定从未在真正的文物上发挥出来. 他们都没有看到一个工作流程,这个工作流程是模型自己写的,然后随着工人对实际工作的报告而调整。

blocks.en: We introduce WorkflowArena to evaluate this capability directly. Evaluating orchestration requires tasks in which the way work is organized changes the result, and a protocol that leaves this organization to the model while recording it and charging its cost against the task. WorkflowArena provides both. Its 145 tasks span 8 work domains and 17 task forms (Figure 1 ) and are built from versioned professional artifacts or from authored scenarios whose dependencies are fully specified. Each task requests a deliverable composed of many separable units that depend on one another, such as clause-level analyses that must be reconciled across a contract portfolio or proofs that build on earlier results, so decisions about decomposition and integration change the outcome. A hidden verifier scores the submission against the task contract, including checks that individually correct but unreconciled components cannot pass. The agent decides whether to delegate at all, and the time spent organizing the work is drawn from the same budget as the work itself. Because every delegation passes through a recorded interface, each outcome can be read together with the workflow that produced it.
blocks.zh: 我们引入WorkflowArena来直接评估这种能力. 评价管弦乐需要组织工作的方式改变结果的任务,以及使这个组织在记录它和按任务收取费用的同时由模型负责的协议。 工作流程Arena提供两者。 其145项任务涵盖8个工作领域和17项任务表(图1),由版本专业文物或作者设想而成,其依赖性已完全明确。 每项任务都要求提供由许多可分离的、相互依存的单位组成的交付品,例如,必须在合同组合中调节的条款层面分析,或以先前结果为基础的证明,因此,关于分解和整合的决定改变了结果。 隐性核查员根据任务合同对提交材料进行评分,包括个别更正但未核对的部件无法通过的检查。 代理人决定是否授权,组织工作所花费的时间与工作本身来自相同的预算。 由于每个代表团都通过一个有记录的接口,因此每个结果都可以与产生结果的工作流程一起阅读。

blocks.en: Our empirical analysis operates at two levels. At the system level, we evaluate 25 configurations of nine models running in Claude Code or Codex. The strongest configuration, Claude Opus 5.5 with Claude Code at max effort, resolves only 36.95% of tasks on average across domains, and no configuration performs best in every domain. Execution traces reveal distinct delegation strategies: at high effort, Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 with Claude Code launch fewer workflows than GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex, but each workflow contains more workers. Because system-level results combine orchestration with the capability of the agents that carry out the work, we also hold the executor fixed: a source model writes and revises the workflow without editing the workspace, and every worker is an instance of a weaker execution model. On a challenging subset of tasks, workflows authored by Opus raise the continuous scores of all four execution models, by 6.41 points on average in the static mode, whereas workflows from Astra, itself far stronger than these executors, help them far less and lower the scores of two of them. Orchestration quality is thus a measurable source of performance that appears distinct from the ability to complete the task alone.
blocks.zh: 我们的经验分析在两个层面运作。 在系统层面,我们评价在克劳德代码或Codex运行的9种模型的25种配置. 最强的配置,克劳德·奥普斯(Claude Opus)5.5和克洛德·科德(Claude Code)在最大努力下,平均只解决36.95%的跨域任务,没有配置在每个领域表现最好. 执行痕迹揭示了不同的授权策略:在高度努力下,克劳德·奥普斯·5.5和克劳德·索内特·5.5和克劳德·代码推出的工作流程少于GPT-6 Astra和GPT-6.1 Sol和Codex,但每个工作流程包含更多的工人. 因为系统层面的成果将管弦乐与执行工作的代理人的能力相结合,所以我们也把执行者固定下来:一个源模型写和修改工作流程而不编辑工作空间,每个工人都是一个执行模式较弱的例子. 在一个具有挑战性的任务子集上,由Opus编写的工作流程将所有四个执行模型的连续得分提高,在静态模式下平均提高6.41分,而来自Astra的工作流程本身远比这些执行者强,帮助他们远为少,降低了其中两个的得分. 因此,管弦乐的质量是可测量的性能来源,似乎不同于单独完成任务的能力。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • Benchmark. We construct WorkflowArena, 145 long-horizon tasks across 8 domains and 17 task forms, in which each deliverable contract is paired with domain-specific hidden verification. • Evaluation protocol. We route every delegation through a recorded interface under a shared time budget while leaving the decision to delegate to the agent, so that its organization of work can be analyzed alongside deliverable outcomes and resource use. • Empirical findings. We compare 25 model–effort configurations by resolved rate and delegation behavior, and use a fixed-executor transfer experiment to isolate the contribution of the workflow and distinguish orchestration quality from solo task performance.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:基准。 我们构建了WorkflowArena,跨越8个领域的145个长视距任务和17个任务表,其中每个可交付合同都配有特定域的隐藏核查。 • 评价程序。 我们让每个代表团在共享时间预算下通过一个有记录的接口,同时将决定权下放给代理人,以便结合可交付成果和资源使用来分析其工作安排。 • 经验调查结果。 我们通过解析率和授权行为来比较25个模型-努力配置,并使用固定执行器传输实验来隔离工作流程的贡献,区分管弦乐质量和独奏任务性能.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Agent evaluation has shifted toward interactive environments with outcome-based verification. AgentBench, WebArena, OSWorld, AppWorld, and SWE-bench ground evaluation in heterogeneous environments, websites, operating systems, applications, and software repositories [ 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 ] . GAIA and AssistantBench assess tool-using assistants on realistic web tasks, while WorkArena and WorkArena++ study enterprise software use and compositional workflows [ 21 , 22 , 23 , 15 ] . TheAgentCompany, MLE-bench, and ScienceAgentBench extend evaluation to workplace tasks, machine learning engineering, and scientific programming [ 24 , 25 , 26 ] , and the τ \tau -bench family evaluates policy-constrained interaction and coordination in shared environments [ 27 , 28 ] . Many of these tasks already involve long horizons and interdependent steps, but the agent is scored as a single unit. WorkflowArena retains their executable environments and independent verification while making the organization of the work observable, since every delegation the agent makes is recorded alongside its deliverable.
blocks.zh: 代理评价已转向基于结果的核查的互动环境。 Bench探员、WebArena、OSWorld、AppWorld、以及SWE-benche地面评价,在不同的环境、网站、操作系统、应用程序和软件库[10、11、12、13、14]。 GAIA和助理Bench评估实用网络任务的工具使用助手,而WorkArena和WorkArena++研究企业软件的使用和组成工作流程[21,22,23,15]. 代理公司、MLE-bench和ScienceAgent Bench将评价范围扩大到工作场所的任务、机器学习工程和科学编程[24、25、26],而\tau-bench家族则评价在共享环境中政策限制的互动和协调[27、28]。 许多这些任务已经涉及了长视野和相互依赖的步骤,但代理人被评为单一单位. WorkflowArena保留其可执行的环境和独立核查,同时使工作安排成为可观察的,因为代理人提出的每个代表团都与交付品一起记录。

blocks.en: MetaGPT, ChatDev, and AutoGen organize collaboration through specialized roles and programmable agent conversations [ 29 , 30 , 31 ] . MultiAgentBench compares coordination protocols, ParallACT studies conflicts among independently tasked agents in shared codebases, and MAST categorizes failure modes of existing systems [ 16 , 17 , 32 ] . A second line of work automates system design by searching over computational graphs, code-defined agents, executable workflows, and modular architectures [ 33 , 34 , 35 , 36 ] ; MaAS samples query-dependent systems from a learned supernet [ 37 ] , and MAS-Loop refines generated systems using execution trajectories [ 38 ] . ADAS and AFlow further report that the designs they discover transfer across models [ 34 , 35 ] . Other systems adapt their structure at run time: DyLAN dynamically selects and connects agents, Magentic-One delegates and replans during execution, and DynaFlow generates executable workflow programs [ 39 , 5 , 7 ] . These methods produce structures through design procedures, fixed controllers, or trained orchestrators, and assess them through downstream task accuracy. WorkflowArena instead treats the structure as an output of the model under evaluation, and its transfer experiment holds the executor fixed so that the contribution of a workflow can be measured separately from the model that authored it.
blocks.zh: MetaGPT,ChatDev,和AutoGen通过专门角色和可编程代理对话组织协作[29,30,31]. MultiAgent Bench比较协调协议,ParallACT研究共享代码库中独立任务代理之间的冲突,MAST将现有系统的故障模式分类 [16, 17, 32]. 第二行工作通过在计算图,代码定义代理,可执行工作流程,模块架构上搜索实现系统设计自动化[33,34,35,36];MaAS从一个学习的超级网中样本依赖查询的系统[37],MAS-Loop通过执行轨迹改进生成的系统[38]. ADAS和AFlow进一步报告说,它们发现的跨模型转移的设计[34,35]. 其他系统在运行时调整其结构: DyLAN动态选择和连接代理,Magentic-One代表和执行期间重新规划,DynaFlow生成可执行的工作流程程序[39,5,7]. 这些方法通过设计程序、固定控制器或训练有素的管弦乐手产生结构,并通过下游任务准确性加以评估。 WorkflowArena转而将结构视为被评价的模型的输出,其传输实验将执行器固定,这样就可以将一个工作流程的贡献与作者的模型分开衡量.

blocks.en: ReAct and Reflexion interleave execution with observation and feedback, ReWOO separates planning from tool observations, and LLMCompiler schedules function calls in parallel [ 1 , 2 , 40 , 9 ] . FlowBench studies planning with supplied workflow knowledge, WorFBench evaluates generated sequence and graph structures together with their downstream utility, and OrchBench isolates orchestration-plan quality through deterministic simulation and validates its scores against real executions [ 18 , 19 , 20 ] . SkillsBench evaluates procedural knowledge by comparing matched conditions with and without skills [ 41 ] . These studies separate the quality of a workflow structure from its realized utility, but they evaluate structures largely offline or in simulation. Interface design and simple execution pipelines can also materially affect task performance, as SWE-agent and Agentless illustrate [ 3 , 42 ] , which motivates evaluating the model together with its harness. WorkflowArena evaluates workflows as they execute on professional artifacts, where the model revises its plan from the results its workers return and the time spent on orchestration counts against the task.
blocks.zh: ReAct and Reflexion 与观测和反馈互开执行,ReWOO将规划与工具观测分开,LLM编译器调度函数并行调用[1,2,40,9]. Flow Bench研究利用提供的工作流程知识进行规划,WorF Bench评价生成的序列和图结构及其下游用途,Orch Bench通过定型模拟将管弦计划质量隔离,并验证其分数与实际处决[18,19,20]. 技能 法官通过比较与技能相匹配和缺乏技能的条件来评价程序性知识[41]。 这些研究将工作流程结构的质量与实现的效用区分开来,但它们主要在离线或模拟中评价结构. 接口设计和简单的执行管道也可能对任务性能产生实质性影响,正如SWE代理和Agentless(英语:SWE-agent and Agentless)所说明的[3,42],它激励着对模型及其牵引力一起进行评估. 工作流程(WorkflowArena)评价在专业文物上执行的工作流程,其中模型根据工人返回的结果修改计划,用于管弦乐的时间与任务不相干。

blocks.en: 3 The WorkflowArena Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 工作流动地区基准

blocks.en: WorkflowArena evaluates agents that organize their own work on long-horizon tasks. A benchmark for this capability must satisfy five requirements. First, organization must be consequential : tasks must contain enough separable and interdependent work that decisions about decomposition and integration change the outcome. Second, it must be autonomous , since a benchmark that prescribed roles or a workflow would measure compliance with that structure rather than the ability to choose one. Third, evaluation must be integration-sensitive , so that individually correct but uncoordinated components do not earn full credit. Fourth, the cost of organizing must be accounted for , so that every organizational step competes with the work itself for time. Fifth, the organization must be observable , so that each outcome can be related to the workflow that produced it. After formalizing the task (§ 3.1 ), we describe how the task design satisfies the first and third requirements (§ 3.2 ) and how the evaluation protocol satisfies the remaining three (§ 3.3 ). The transfer experiment in § 4.5 complements these properties by separating the contribution of a workflow from the capability of the agents that execute it.
blocks.zh: WorkflowArena评价那些自行组织工作执行长视距任务的代理商. 这一能力的基准必须满足五项要求。 首先,组织必须产生结果:任务必须包含足够的可分离和相互依存的工作,以便分解和整合的决定改变结果。 第二,它必须是自主的,因为规定作用或工作流程的基准将衡量遵守这一结构的情况,而不是选择这一结构的能力。 第三,评价必须注重一体化,以便个别纠正但未协调的构成部分不会获得充分的信贷。 第四,必须说明组织费用,以便每个组织步骤都与工作本身竞争一段时间。 第五,本组织必须可观察,以便每个成果都与产生成果的工作流程相关。 在正式确定任务(第3.1节)之后,我们描述任务设计如何满足第一项和第三项要求(第3.2节),以及评价协议如何满足其余三项要求(第3.3节)。 §4.5中的传输实验通过将工作流程的贡献与执行该流程的代理的能力区分开来来补充这些属性.

blocks.en: 3.1 Task formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 任务拟定

blocks.en: A WorkflowArena task is a tuple τ = ( s 0 , g , 𝒰 , ℰ , ℬ , V ) , \tau=(s_{0},g,\mathcal{U},\mathcal{E},\mathcal{B},V), (1) where s 0 s_{0} is the initial environment state, g g is the goal stated to the agent, 𝒰 \mathcal{U} is the public action and tool surface, ℰ \mathcal{E} is the set of task artifacts and execution environments, ℬ \mathcal{B} is the resource budget, and V V is an independent verifier. blocks.en: 3.2 Task design and construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 任务设计和施工

blocks.en: WorkflowArena contains 145 tasks organized at two levels (Figure 1 ; Table 3 in Appendix A ). The 8 domains identify the work setting, ranging from software and enterprise operations to law and 3D production, and the 17 task forms identify the deliverable and its verification structure within each domain. Tasks are selected for three properties that together make organization consequential. A substantial workload supplies separable units of work that can be assigned to different workers. Dependencies or shared constraints among these units make their ordering and integration matter. Scoring criteria defined on the integrated deliverable ensure that these decisions are reflected in the result. The properties constrain what the agent must deliver while leaving decomposition and execution order to the agent, as summarized in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 工作流程(WorkingflowArena)包含145项分为两个级别的任务(图1;附录A表3)。 这8个领域确定了从软件和企业业务到法律和三维生产等各种工作环境,17个任务表确定了每个领域的交付品及其核查结构。 任务被选为三个属性,这些属性共同使组织产生后果. 工作量很大,可以分给不同的工人。 这些单位的依赖性或共同的制约使得它们的命令和一体化成为重要因素。 关于综合交付品的评级标准确保这些决定反映在结果中。 如图2所示,属性限制代理人在将分解和执行命令留给代理人时必须交付的东西。

blocks.en: Tasks are built from real professional materials, from open-source repositories and formal mathematics libraries to corporate filings, legal agreements, and media assets; Table 3 lists the sources for each task form. These materials supply the scale, structure, and domain conventions of the work. Where a setting requires controlled state transitions or exceptions, as in operational processes and multi-entity accounting, the materials are embedded in authored scenarios whose dependencies are fully specified.
blocks.zh: 任务由真正的专业材料、开源寄存器和正式的数学图书馆、企业档案、法律协议和媒体资产组成; 表3列出了每个任务表的来源。 这些材料提供了工作的规模、结构和领域惯例。 在设定需要控制状态过渡或例外的情况下,例如在操作程序和多实体核算中,材料嵌入了作者的假设情景中,其依赖性得到了充分说明。

blocks.en: Interdependence gives decomposition and integration their consequences, and it is expressed as requirements on the final deliverable. In a contract-portfolio task, each agreement can be analyzed clause by clause, yet the deliverable also requires relations and conflicts across contracts, so separately produced analyses must be reconciled into one consistent report. In a multi-entity consolidation task, adjustments to each entity propagate through intercompany balances into the consolidated ledger. In formal proof construction, the target proofs belong to a development in which later results rely on earlier ones, and in 3D scene construction, separately built components must meet at shared spatial interfaces. Predictive modeling instead rewards exploring alternative approaches that are later compared and combined. In every case, units may be developed separately, but the evaluation examines how they fit together in the submitted result.
blocks.zh: 相互依存导致其后果的分解和整合,并被表述为对最终交付品的要求。 在合同组合任务中,可以通过条款对每项协议进行分析,但交付品还要求合同之间的关系和冲突,因此,单独制作的分析必须调和成一份一致的报告。 在一个多实体合并任务中,每个实体的调整通过公司间余额传播到合并分类账中。 在正式的证明构造中,目标证明属于一种开发,其中后期的结果依赖于早期的证明,在3D场景构造中,单独建造的组件必须在共享的空间界面中满足. 相反,预测性模型将有利于探讨以后比较和合并的替代办法。 在每一种情况下,单位都可以单独发展,但评价审查它们如何在提交的结果中结合起来。

blocks.en: Each task specifies an initial workspace, a target deliverable, and task-specific constraints. For reconstruction tasks, the target work is removed while the surrounding context is retained. The task contract states the requirements on the deliverable, whereas reference outputs and hidden checks are excluded from the agent-facing workspace. Acceptance is defined on the final artifact. Wherever units of work depend on one another, the contract includes checks that only an integrated result can pass, such as regression tests in software or reconciliation in accounting. Operational tasks are additionally evaluated on their action histories, because a correct final state can be reached through an invalid process.
blocks.zh: 每项任务都规定了初始工作空间、可实现目标和具体任务的限制。 对于重建任务,目标工作在保留周围环境的同时被移除. 任务合同规定了对交付品的要求,而参考产出和隐蔽检查则被排除在提供代理的工作空间之外。 接受的定义是最终的文物。 凡工作单位相互依赖的,合同包括只有综合结果才能通过的检查,如软件中的回归测试或会计中的调节. 行动任务还在其行动史上得到额外评价,因为可以通过无效的过程达到正确的最终状态.

blocks.en: Human experts review the instructions, materials, and scoring criteria of each task, and tasks with ambiguous requirements, defective materials, or no substantive integration are excluded. Each retained verifier is tested against reference solutions and against submissions that should fail. Among the latter, submissions with correct components but no integration keep the evaluation integration-sensitive, since delegated components that are never reconciled cannot pass; submissions that reach a correct outcome through an invalid process play the same role for process constraints. Appendix A details the source material and instantiation of each task form.
blocks.zh: 人类专家审查每项任务的指示、材料和评分标准,排除了要求不明确、材料有缺陷或没有实质性整合的任务。 每个被保留的核查人都要根据参考解决方案和应失败的提交书进行测试。 在后者中,具有正确组成部分但集成度不高的呈件保持评价集成度的敏感性,因为从未调和的委派构成部分无法通过;通过无效流程得出正确结果的呈件在流程制约方面发挥着同样的作用。 附 录 一个细节是每个任务表的来源材料和即时性.

blocks.en: 3.3 Evaluation protocol
blocks.zh: 3.3 评价协议

blocks.en: We evaluate complete model–harness configurations under a common end-to-end wall-clock budget of four hours. Each task starts from a clean container workspace, and the budget is shared by the main agent and its workers. It covers all activity after the task starts, whereas environment preparation and grading lie outside it. Because the budget is shared, organization has a cost: parallel workers can shorten the critical path, but every step needed to coordinate them consumes the same time as the work itself. Task outcomes therefore reflect deliverable quality under a fixed time constraint, while token consumption and estimated inference cost characterize the resources each configuration uses.
blocks.zh: 我们评价完整的模型 - harness配置 在一个共同的 端到端的时钟预算 四小时。 每个任务都从一个干净的容器工作空间开始,预算由主要代理人及其工人分担。 它涵盖任务开始后的所有活动,而环境准备和分级则不在它范围之内。 由于预算是分担的,组织成本是:平行工人可以缩短关键路径,但协调他们所需的每一个步骤都消耗与工作本身相同的时间. 因此,任务成果反映了在固定时限内可交付的质量,而象征性消费和估计推论成本是每个配置使用的资源的特点。

blocks.en: The agent has full access to the task workspace, including the shell, tests, and direct file editing. It is also given a Workflow tool that launches background workflows with up to 16 concurrent workers and allows the agent to inspect, stop, and revise them. We write Workflow for this tool and its invocations, and workflow for the general concept. Each worker is a fresh instance of the agent itself, with the same model, harness, and effort. Because workers start from a fresh context and share only the workspace, the agent must decide what each worker needs to know, which makes context allocation part of the evaluated behavior. Native sub-agent mechanisms are disabled, so every delegation passes through the Workflow tool and is recorded. Using the tool remains optional, which leaves the decision to delegate entirely to the agent. The agent may revise its workflow in response to public execution feedback until it stops or exhausts the budget, after which the verifier scores the final artifact. Each execution thus yields a trace of Workflow invocations, worker executions, and revisions, together with the time and tokens consumed by the main agent and each worker.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: The experiments address the research question from three perspectives. After describing the setup (§ 4.1 ), we measure how far agents accomplish the tasks through task performance (§ 4.2 ) and resource use (§ 4.3 ). We then examine how they organize the work, characterizing delegation across systems, effort settings, and domains (§ 4.4 ). Because system-level outcomes combine orchestration with execution capability, a transfer experiment holds the executor fixed to isolate the contribution of the workflow itself (§ 4.5 ). Finally, three 3D construction tasks illustrate in detail what the resulting workflows look like (§ 4.6 ).
blocks.zh: 实验从三个角度解决了研究问题. 在描述设置(第4.1节)后,我们衡量代理人通过任务执行(第4.2节)和资源使用(第4.3节)完成任务的程度。 然后,我们审查他们如何安排工作,描述跨系统、努力环境和领域的权力下放(第4.4节)。 由于系统层面的结果将管弦与执行能力相结合,转移实验将执行器固定在隔离工作流程本身的贡献上(§4.5). 最后,三项三维施工任务详细说明了由此产生的工作流程的长相(第4.6节)。

blocks.en: We characterize delegation with two quantities. Workflow calls per task is the total number of Workflow invocations divided by the number of tasks, including tasks without invocations. A Workflow invocation is an invocation-start event deduplicated by call identifier; list, query, and read operations are excluded.

blocks.en: 4.5 Workflow transfer across execution models
blocks.zh: 4.5 跨执行模式的工作流程转移

blocks.en: The preceding analyses characterize how systems organize their work, but system-level outcomes combine the quality of a workflow with the capability of the agents that carry it out. To separate the two, we hold the executor fixed and vary only the source of the workflow on a challenging subset of 32 tasks (Appendix E ). Astra and Opus serve as workflow sources at max effort, and Kimi, DeepSeek, Luna, and Doubao serve as execution models; every worker is an instance of the execution model. In the static mode, the source model reads the task instruction and the clean initial workspace, writes a Workflow program, and then stops; the frozen program runs in a fresh workspace, where its internal branches, loops, and parallel stages still execute. In the dynamic mode, which follows Claude Code dynamic workflows [ 6 ] , the source model launches Workflows, observes worker results, and revises the workflow throughout execution. Unlike the main agent in § 3.3 , the source model cannot edit the workspace in either mode, so all task work is performed by the execution model’s workers. Workflow generation counts against the same wall-clock budget. For each execution model, we compare the four transferred settings against its own dynamic workflow (Table 2 ). Because resolved rates on a 32-task subset change in coarse steps, we report continuous scores for this experiment to capture finer-grained differences between settings.
blocks.zh: 上述分析说明了各系统如何安排其工作,但系统一级的成果将工作流程的质量与执行工作流程的机构的能力结合起来。 为了将两者分开,我们将执行器固定下来,并且只改变工作流程的来源,用于一个具有挑战性的32项任务的子集(附录E . Astra和Opus以最大努力作为工作流程来源,Kimi、DeepSeek、Luna和Doubao充当执行模式;每个工人都是执行模式的典范。 在静态模式中,源模式读取任务指令和干净的初始工作空间,写出一个工作流程程序,然后停止;被冻结的程序运行在一个新鲜的工作空间中,其内部分支,循环,以及平行阶段仍然执行. 在遵循Claude Code动态工作流程的动态模式[6]中,源模式推出Workflows,观察工人结果,并在整个执行过程中修改工作流程. 与§3.3中的主要代理不同,源模型无法在任一模式中编辑工作空间,因此所有任务工作都由执行模型的工人完成. 劳动力的产生与同一时数的预算相抵。 对于每个执行模式,我们比较了四个被转移的设置与其自己的动态工作流程(表2 ). 因为在粗细步骤的32个任务子集变化上解析的速率,我们为这个实验报告连续的分数,以捕捉到设置之间更细细的差别.

blocks.en: Table 2 : Workflow transfer on a challenging subset. Astra and Opus generate workflows at max effort for execution by the models listed below. Self denotes the execution model acting as its own source in the dynamic mode. Bold and underlined values indicate the best and second-best scores in each row.

blocks.en: With Opus dynamic workflows, Kimi improves from 35.75 to 46.61 and DeepSeek from 18.37 to 25.24, while Luna and Doubao obtain their highest scores with Opus static workflows, at 30.37 and 28.04. Averaged over the four executors, Opus workflows add 6.41 points in the static mode and 6.27 in the dynamic mode. Because the source model never edits the workspace, these gains arise from the workflow it authors, including the instructions it gives each worker, rather than from work performed by the source.
blocks.zh: 随着Opus动态工作流程,Kimi从35.75提高到46.61,DeepSeek从18.37提高到25.24,而Luna和Doubao则以Opus静态工作流程获得最高分,分别为30.37和28.04. 平均在四个执行器上,Opus工作流程在静态模式中加6.41分,在动态模式中加6.27分. 由于源模型从不编辑工作空间,这些收益来自于其作者的工作流程,包括它给每个工人的指示,而不是来源完成的工作.

blocks.en: Astra workflows transfer far less well, averaging − 2.53 -2.53 points in the static mode and + 1.34 +1.34 in the dynamic mode; they lower the scores of Kimi and DeepSeek in both modes and exceed the executor’s own workflow only for Doubao in both modes and for Luna in the dynamic mode. Yet Astra is itself a far stronger system than any of the four executors, resolving 27.34% of tasks at max effort compared with at most 16.48% for the executors. Strong solo performance therefore does not by itself yield workflows that help other models, which suggests that the ability to orchestrate others is not simply a byproduct of the ability to complete the task.
blocks.zh: Astra工作流程的传输远没有那么好,在静态模式中平均为2.53–2.53分,在动态模式中为1.34+1.34分;在两种模式中,它们都降低了Kimi和DeepSeek的得分,并且只为Doubao和在动态模式中为Luna执行者自己的工作流程。 然而,Astra本身是一个比四个执行者中任何一个都强得多的系统,以最大努力解决27.34%的任务,而执行者最多16.48%。 因此,强大的独奏性能本身并不能产生有助于其他模型的工作流程,这表明协调他人的能力不仅仅是完成任务能力的副产品.

blocks.en: 4.6 Case study: orchestrating 3D scene construction
blocks.zh: 4.6 国家 个案研究:3D场景建筑

blocks.en: The aggregate measures in § 4.4 summarize how often and how widely systems delegate, but not what the resulting workflows look like. Three 3D construction tasks illustrate distinct forms of workflow organization: iterative component integration in the palace, spatial decomposition in the cathedral, and drawing analysis for centralized construction in the fortress. Figure 9 pairs the delivered artifacts with the corresponding workflows of Opus in Claude Code and Astra in Codex. Each task requires a Blender scene, renders, and a manifest that reconciles construction drawings with a change order.
blocks.zh: 第4.4节中的汇总计量总结了系统代表的频率和范围,但并没有概括由此产生的工作流程的模样。 三个3D建筑任务说明了不同的工作流程组织形式:宫殿的迭代组件集成,大教堂的空间分解,以及堡垒集中建设的绘图分析. 图9将交付的文物与Claude Code和Astra在Codex中的相应工作流程对齐。 每项任务都需要一个Blender场景,制作,以及一个能调和建筑图纸与更改顺序的显示.

Upper panels show overview renders, scores, and architectural details; lower panels reconstruct the workflows and their worker calls. Dot colors follow the legend and mark preparation or drawing analysis, initial construction, and integration, checking, repair, or rebuilding. Dots represent worker calls and diamonds main-agent stages; arrows indicate dependencies and handoffs.

blocks.en: In the palace, both workflows distribute construction across components: Opus runs seven builders followed by assembly and iterative repairs, whereas Astra first establishes a shared foundation and then assigns assembly to a single worker. In the cathedral, Opus makes two sequential whole-scene attempts, whereas Astra divides the scene among three regional builders and a separate assembly worker, which introduces interfaces at shared structural positions. In the fortress, both workflows rely on a single whole-scene builder, but Opus precedes construction with seven drawing-analysis calls, whereas Astra audits the drawings concurrently with construction. Delegation therefore serves two distinct purposes across these tasks, building components in parallel and preparing the inputs of a central builder, and integration and repair enter the workflow at different stages.
blocks.zh: 在宫殿里,两个工作流程将建筑分成不同部分: 奥普斯经营7个建筑商,随后进行组装和迭代维修,而阿斯特拉首先建立共享的地基,然后将组装分配给一个工人. 在大教堂中,奥普斯进行了两次连续的全景尝试,而Astra则将场景划分为三个区域建设者和一个单独的组装工人,在共享结构位置上引入接口. 在要塞中,两个工作流程都依赖于一个单一的全景建筑商,但Opus在建筑前有7个绘图分析呼叫,而Astra同时对图纸进行审核. 因此,代表团在这些任务中有两个不同的目的:同时建立组成部分和准备中央建设者的投入;整合和修理在不同阶段进入工作流程。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: WorkflowArena evaluates agents that organize their own work on long-horizon tasks. Its 145 tasks span 8 domains and 17 task forms, and each pairs professional source material or an authored scenario with an explicit initial state, an interdependent deliverable, and hidden domain-specific verification. Every delegation passes through a recorded interface under a shared time budget, so each result can be read together with the workflow that produced it.
blocks.zh: WorkflowArena评价那些自行组织工作执行长视距任务的代理商. 其145项任务涉及8个领域和17个任务表,每个任务表都配对专业源材料或有明确初始状态、相互依存的可交付性以及隐藏的特定领域核查的作者情景。 每个代表团在一个共享的时间预算下通过一个有记录的界面,因此每个结果都可以与产生结果的工作流程一起阅读.

blocks.en: Returning to the question posed in the introduction, current agents can orchestrate multi-agent workflows for long-horizon tasks, but they remain far from accomplishing them reliably: the strongest configuration, Opus with Claude Code at max effort, fully resolves only 36.95% of tasks on average across domains, and no configuration leads every domain. How the agents organize their work also differs systematically. At high effort, the Claude models in Claude Code delegate less often but in larger groups, whereas the GPT models in Codex delegate more often in smaller units, and within each system the task domain further shapes how often and how widely work is delegated. Holding the executor fixed on a challenging subset shows that this organization matters in its own right: workflows authored by Opus raise the score of every execution model, while workflows from Astra, itself a much stronger system than these executors, help far less. The quality of orchestration thus appears to be a measurable source of performance that is distinct from the ability to complete the task alone.
blocks.zh: 回到导言中提出的问题,目前的代理商可以为长视距任务协调多代理工作流程,但它们仍然远未可靠地完成这些任务:最强的配置,Opus和Claude Code在最大努力下,平均只解决36.95%的跨域任务,没有配置引导每个域. 各机构如何安排其工作也存在系统性差异。 克洛德法典中的克洛德模型在大量努力中代表较少,但在较大的群体中代表较少,而Codex中的GPT模型则在较小的单位中代表较多,在每一个系统中,任务领域进一步决定了工作被授权的频率和范围。 将执行器固定在一个具有挑战性的子集上,表明这个组织本身就很重要:由Opus编写的工作流程提高了每个执行模式的分数,而Astra的工作流程本身比这些执行者强得多,帮助却少得多。 因此,组织工作的质量似乎是一个可衡量的业绩来源,不同于单独完成任务的能力。

blocks.en: Each configuration is evaluated once per task, so differences between closely ranked configurations are reported without variance estimates. Each model is evaluated in a single harness, and differences between the Claude and GPT systems therefore reflect the model and its harness jointly; the non-GPT models that run in Claude Code provide only a partial basis for separating the two. Content and 3D deliverables are graded against task rubrics by an LLM judge, and agreement with human graders is not measured in this work. The transfer experiment uses a subset of the benchmark and two source models, and because source models also write the instructions given to workers, its gains may combine better organization with task knowledge conveyed in those instructions.
blocks.zh: 每个配置每任务评价一次,因此在报告紧密排序的配置之间的差异时不作差异估计. 每个模型都用单一的牵引力来评价,因此克劳德系统与GPT系统之间的差异共同反映了模型及其牵引力;在克劳德码中运行的非GPT模型只提供了将两者分开的部分基础. 内容和3D交付品由LLM法官对照任务主题进行分级,本作中不衡量与人类分级者的一致. 转移实验使用基准的子集和两个源模型,由于源模型也写给工人的指示,其收益可能将更好的组织与这些指示中传达的任务知识结合起来.

blocks.en: Because WorkflowArena records both the deliverable and the workflow that produced it, it also supports future study of heterogeneous systems in which the orchestrator and its workers use different models, as well as adaptive budgets and interactive task execution.
blocks.zh: 由于WorkflowArena既记录了交付品,也记录了产生交付品的工作流程,它也支持今后研究各种系统,其中管弦乐团及其工作人员使用不同的模型,以及适应性预算和交互式任务执行。

Appendix B Task Package Format

blocks.en: Task packages follow the Harbor execution interface. Each package contains an agent-facing instruction ( instruction.md ), an environment specification ( environment/ ), a verifier entry point ( tests/ ), and task metadata. The instruction defines the required deliverable and execution constraints, while the environment provides the initial workspace and task inputs. Hidden tests and reference assets are kept separate from the agent-facing materials. After execution, the verifier evaluates the final submission and any task-relevant state transitions to produce the task score.
blocks.zh: 任务包遵循港湾执行接口. 每个软件包都包含一个代理发报指令(discription.md),一个环境规格(环境/),一个验证器切入点(测试/),以及任务元数据. 该指令界定了所需的可交付和执行限制,而环境则提供了初步的工作空间和任务投入。 隐藏的测试和参考资产与制剂材料分开保存。 执行后,核查者评价最终提交和任何与任务相关的状态过渡以产生任务分数.

blocks.en: Appendix C Task-Specific Scoring Criteria
blocks.zh: 附录C 特定任务计分标准

blocks.en: Each task is evaluated with a continuous score on a 0–100 scale. The verifier assesses the submitted deliverable against the requirements in the task contract. Component checks contribute to this score through the task-specific scoring rule.
blocks.zh: 每项任务均以0-100级的连续评分进行评分. 核查人根据任务合同的要求评估提交的交付品。 组件检查通过任务特定评分规则为这一分数作出贡献.

blocks.en: Software and formal mathematics scores reflect progress across functional groups or required targets, together with build and integrity checks. Operational scores combine outcome, process, and constraint checks. Financial and legal scores account for both local analyses and their integration into a consistent final report. Scientific reproduction uses target-specific numerical tolerances, while predictive modeling uses the official metric and a fixed reference population. Content and 3D scores use weighted rubrics covering substantive requirements and delivery quality, including narrative coherence, geometry, and cross-component consistency where applicable; these rubrics are scored by Gemini-3.8-Flash.
blocks.zh: 软件和正规数学分数反映了不同功能组别或所需目标的进展,以及构建和完整性检查。 业务分数结合了结果、过程和制约检查。 财务和法律分数既用于当地分析,也用于将其纳入一致的最后报告。 科学复制使用目标特定的数值耐受性,而预测模型则使用官方的度量和固定的参考人口. 内容和3D分数使用包含实质性要求和交付质量的加权分数,包括叙述一致性,几何,以及适用的交叉组件一致性;这些分数由双子座-3.8-Flash分数.

blocks.en: The task contract specifies the scoring weights, tolerances, equivalence rules, and required checks. Artifact evaluation combines technical inspection with semantic review: media must satisfy the requested narrative and editing requirements, and scenes must satisfy the specified geometry and spatial relationships. The resulting score captures the extent to which the final deliverable fulfills the task.
blocks.zh: 任务合同规定了评分权重、容忍度、等值规则和必要的检查。 艺术评价结合技术检查和语义审查:媒体必须满足所要求的叙述和编辑要求,场景必须满足指定的几何和空间关系. 由此产生的得分记录了最终交付品完成这项任务的程度。

blocks.en: Appendix D Execution and Resource Accounting
blocks.zh: 附录D 执行和资源核算

blocks.en: D.1 Model and execution configuration
blocks.zh: D.1 模式和执行配置

blocks.en: Table 4 lists the API model identifiers and harness versions. The main agent and its workers use the same registered model, harness, and effort. Model identifiers are passed to the API through the execution broker, which also enforces the effort setting. Codex is pinned to version 0.164.0 and Claude Code to version 2.1.280. The trial registration records the agent profile, protocol options, task-package hash, and container image identifiers. At execution start, the runner archives its Python implementation, prompt templates, JavaScript runtime, and interface schemas with SHA-256 hashes. These artifacts identify the executable configuration of each trial independently of subsequent repository changes.
blocks.zh: 表4列出了API模型标识符和调用版本. 主要代理人及其工人使用同样的注册模型、绳索和努力。 模型识别符通过执行经纪人传递给API,后者也执行努力设定. Codex被固定在0.164.0版本,Claude Code被固定在2.1280版本. 试验登记记录了代理简介、协议选项、任务包散列和集装箱图像标识符。 执行开始时,跑者将它的Python执行,即时模板,JavaScript运行时间,以及SHA-256散列的接口计划存档. 这些文物独立于随后的寄存器变化,确定每个试验的可执行配置.

blocks.en: Task execution takes place in Docker containers, with model inference accessed through the broker. The task package specifies CPU and memory limits for each agent container; these override the generic agent-profile defaults. The runner records the effective limits, CPU affinity when applicable, and resolved image identifier in the execution record. A host-level admission controller reserves CPU and memory before starting a container and holds the reservation until cleanup. Its capacity is bounded by 90% of the host’s reported CPUs and 85% of its memory, with any explicitly configured host caps applied as additional limits. The resulting capacity and container reservations are recorded alongside the trial. Thus, task-level resource declarations and effective container allocations specify the compute available for shell commands, tests, rendering, and other local work.
blocks.zh: 任务执行在Docker容器中进行,模型推论通过经纪人访问. 任务包为每个代理容器指定了CPU和内存限制;这些包可以覆盖通用代理配置默认值. 运行者记录有效限值, CPU 相近性( 如果适用), 并在执行记录中解析图像标识符 。 主机级的录取控制器在启动容器之前保留CPU和内存,并持有预留直到清理. 其容量以90%的主机报告的CPU和85%的内存为限制,任何明确配置的主机封顶作为附加限制. 由此产生的容量和集装箱预定在试验的同时记录。 因此,任务一级的资源申报和有效的集装箱分配具体规定了可用于壳体指令、测试、渲染和其他当地工作的计算。

blocks.en: The four-hour protocol uses a 14,400-second deadline shared by the main agent and all workers. The execution loop establishes this deadline using a monotonic clock and passes the remaining time to each agent invocation. Worker dispatch, container admission waits, tool execution, provider queueing, and retry backoff consume the same budget; launching or resuming a Workflow does not reset it. Task preparation precedes this execution window, and grading follows it. Worker concurrency is capped at 16. The broker separately limits simultaneous upstream requests to the registered concurrency and applies a 240-second queue timeout.
blocks.zh: 4小时协议使用14400秒的最后期限,由主要代理人和所有工人共同承担. 执行循环使用一个单调时钟确定这个最后期限,并将剩余时间传递给每个代理引用. 工人调度、集装箱接收等待、工具执行、供应商排队和重试后退消耗同样的预算;启动或恢复工作流程不会重置。 任务准备在此执行窗口之前, 并随之进行分级 。 工人货币上限为16。 经纪人将同时的上游请求分别限制在注册货币范围内,并应用240秒的队列超时.

blocks.en: Transient transport failures, rate-limit responses, and provider overloads are handled by the broker. Backoff grows exponentially, is capped at 30 seconds, and adds up to 0.3 seconds of jitter; a valid provider Retry-After value of at most 120 seconds can extend the wait. Retries remain bounded by the request deadline and the transport policy in the archived implementation. The broker records the attempt limit, response status, queue time, elapsed time, and backoff for each request. Native harness request retries are disabled when broker-managed retries are enabled, avoiding nested retry loops. Delivered model or tool events are not replayed after a stream failure. Provider-side service capacity is external to the container resource allocation; its observed waits are included in the execution time.
blocks.zh: 临时运输故障,限速响应,供应商超载由经纪人处理. 后退呈指数增长,在30秒时被封顶,加起来为0.3秒的焦距;有效的提供者Retry-After值最多120秒可以延长等待时间. 在存档执行中,退货仍受请求截止日期和运输政策的约束。 经纪人记录每个请求的尝试限制、响应状态、排队时间、经过时间和备份。 当启用经纪人管理的重试时,本地的重试请求被禁用,避免嵌入式重试循环. 交付的模型或工具事件在流失败后不会重播. 供应方的服务能力与集装箱资源分配无关;其观察到的等候时间计入执行时间。

blocks.en: D.2 Prompts and tool interfaces
blocks.zh: D.2 提示和工具接口

blocks.en: The initial message to the main agent consists of three parts. The first sets up the task. It points the agent to the task instruction in /testbed/instruction.md , states that the workspace is writable, and allows the agent to work directly, to delegate through Workflows, or to combine the two, without a required planning stage and without prescribed roles, topology, or worker count. It asks the agent to prioritize correctness and completeness before elapsed time and token consumption, to coordinate file ownership among workers that share the workspace, to give each worker the context it needs because workers start from fresh conversations, and to confirm that the final deliverable is in place before finishing. It also reports the total and remaining time budget and notes that launching a Workflow does not reset it. The second part defines Workflow programs, including their script format and the interface described below, and advises that the structure of a workflow should follow the task rather than a fixed template of stages. The third part describes runtime details, such as where execution transcripts can be inspected and how changes made in isolated worktrees must be integrated. Each subsequent turn begins with a short continuation message that reports execution feedback and the remaining budget.
blocks.zh: 给主要代理人的初始信息由三部分组成. 首座设使. 它在/testbed/instruction.md中将代理人指向任务指示,指出工作空间是可写字的,并允许代理人直接工作,通过工作流程进行委托,或者将两者结合起来,没有规定的规划阶段,也没有规定的角色,地形或工人计数. 它要求代理人在时间和象征性消耗之前优先确定正确性和完整性,协调共享工作空间的工人的档案所有权,为每个工人提供其所需的背景,因为工人从新的对话开始,并确认最后交付品在完成之前就已经到位。 它还报告总和剩余时间预算,并指出,启动工作流程不会重设。 第二部分定义了Workflow程序,包括其脚本格式和下面描述的界面,并建议工作流程的结构应该遵循任务而不是固定的阶段模板. 第三部分描述了运行时间的细节,例如哪里可以检查执行记录以及必须如何整合孤立的工作树上所作的改变. 其后的每个回合开始时都有一个简短的延续信息,报告执行情况反馈和其余预算。

blocks.en: The harness retains its versioned native instructions. Benchmark messages and worker assignments are supplied explicitly; automatic discovery of host project instructions, memories, and skills is disabled. Workflow workers start with fresh conversations and receive the assignment and public task workspace. Optional role instructions use the harness instruction channel: Codex’s developer instructions or Claude Code’s appended system prompt. The runner saves the rendered worker prompt and role-instruction hash. Workers share /testbed by default; isolated Git worktrees require explicit integration by the agent.
blocks.zh: 吊带保留其版本的本土指令. 明确提供基准信息和工人任务;自动发现东道项目指示、记忆和技能被禁用。 工作流程工人从新的对话开始,接受分配和公共工作空间。 可选角色指令使用 jap 指令通道 : Codex 的开发者指令或 Claude 代码的附加系统提示 。 跑者节省了工人的迅速和角色指示散列。 工人共享/默认测试;孤立的Git工作树需要代理人明确整合.

blocks.en: The main agent receives five Workflow interfaces: Workflow launches a background JavaScript program; WorkflowList lists runs and active workers; WorkflowOutput retrieves status or results and can wait for up to 30 seconds; WorkflowStop cancels a run and its workers; and WorkflowControl pauses or resumes dispatch, or stops or restarts an individual worker. Their JSON schemas are supplied through MCP. Workflow programs compose agent , parallel , and pipeline calls, the primitives of Claude Code dynamic workflows [ 6 ] , with ordinary JavaScript control flow; both harnesses receive the same interface. Environment operations are performed through worker tools. Claude Code exposes reading, searching, shell execution, and file editing; Codex exposes the corresponding native workspace tools and local image inspection. Native sub-agent tools are disabled, so delegation passes through the recorded Workflow interface.
blocks.zh: 主代理接收5个工作流程接口: 工作流程启动一个背景 JavaScript 程序; 工作流程列表运行和活跃的工人; WorkflowOutput 获取状态或结果,最多可等30秒; 工作流程停止取消运行及其工人; 工作流程控制暂停或恢复发送,或停止或重新启动单个工人. 他们的JSON计划通过MCP提供. Workflow程序组成代理,并行,和管道调用,克劳德代码动态工作流程的原始版本[6],具有普通的JavaScript控制流量;两种牵引器都接收到相同的接口. 环境业务是通过工人工具进行的。 克劳德 代码曝光阅读,搜索, shell执行,以及文件编辑; Codex曝光相应的本土工作空间工具和本地图像检查. 原生子代理工具被禁用,因此授权通过录制的Workflow接口.

blocks.en: D.3 Token categories and inference-cost calculation
blocks.zh: D.3 托肯类别和推算费用计算

blocks.en: For each task, usage is summed over the main agent and Workflow workers, including recorded retry attempts. We normalize usage into four disjoint categories: uncached input I I , cache reads R R , cache writes W W , and output O O . For Responses-style records, the reported input count already includes cached input, so I = T input − R − W I=T_{\mathrm{input}}-R-W . For Messages-style records, the reported input count excludes cache reads and writes, so I = T input I=T_{\mathrm{input}} . In both cases, total token consumption is I + R + W + O I+R+W+O . Reasoning tokens already included in output are not added again, and audit summaries of the same calls are not counted as additional usage.
blocks.zh: 对每项任务,主要代理人和工作流程工人,包括记录的重复试验,都要加以归纳。 我们将使用规范化为四个脱节的分类:未标记的输入 I I,缓存读取 R R,缓存写出 W W,输出 O O 。 对于响应式记录,所报输入数已经包含缓存输入,所以I=T输入−R− W = T_{\ mathrm{ input} - R- W 。 对于信件类记录,所报输入数不包括缓存读写,所以 I = T 输入 I=T_{\ mathrm{ input} 。 在这两种情况下,代号消费总量为I+R+W+OI+R+W+O. 产出中已包含的理由令牌不再添加,对相同电话的审计摘要也不算作额外使用.

Table 4 gives the price snapshot used in the calculation. The estimate uses standard short-context pricing, five-minute cache-write pricing for Claude and Kimi, and the peak tariff for DeepSeek. For GLM, Doubao, and DeepSeek, cache creation is priced as uncached input. Doubao’s CNY prices are converted at 6.7168 CNY per USD, using the exchange-rate snapshot of November 6, 2026. The estimate covers token-based model inference; grading, tools, container infrastructure, taxes, and time-based cache storage are outside this quantity.

Doubao的CNY价格按每美元6.7168CNY折算,使用2026年11月6日的汇率快照. 估计数包括基于符号的模型推论;分级、工具、集装箱基础设施、税收和基于时间的缓存储存不在此数之列。

blocks.zh: 附录F 接受 标准和确定的比率

blocks.en: Table 5 lists the acceptance criteria that determine whether a task is resolved, as defined in § 3.3 . Thresholds apply to each task, and critical checks are required in addition to any score threshold.
blocks.zh: 表5列出了第3.3节所界定的确定一项任务是否得到解决的接受标准。 阈值适用于每项任务,除任何得分阈值外,还需要进行临界检查.

blocks.zh: 表5:用于计算解决率的接受标准。

blocks.en: The two overall measures order the 25 configurations similarly, with a Spearman rank correlation of 0.90 between Overall Resolved and Overall Score, but they diverge sharply within domains. Averaged over the 25 configurations, the continuous domain score exceeds the domain resolved rate by 11.23 points in MATH, 32.71 in CDN, 34.73 in SCI, 38.33 in OPS, 47.25 in 3D, 61.18 in FIN, 66.16 in SWE, and 67.76 in LAW. MATH is the only domain in which the two measures nearly coincide, because its acceptance criteria are close to the scoring rule itself: every required declaration must type-check under the prescribed axioms. In SWE, FIN, and LAW, by contrast, submissions routinely earn most of the partial credit while missing at least one acceptance criterion. Opus at high effort scores 96.98 in SWE yet resolves 17.65% of SWE tasks, and LAW averages a score of 70.7 across configurations but a resolved rate of only 2.9%.
blocks.zh: 两项总体措施对25个配置的排序类似,Spearman在 " 总决心 " 和 " 总得分 " 之间排名为0.90,但它们在域内差异很大。 平均在25个配置中,连续域分数超过域解析率,MATH为11.23分,CDN为32.71分,SCI为34.73分,OPS为38.33分,3D为47.25分,FIN为61.18分,SWE为66.16分,LAW为67.76分. MATH是两项措施几乎一致的唯一领域,因为它的接受标准接近评分规则本身:每一份要求的申报都必须在规定的轴线下进行打字检查. 相比之下,在瑞典、芬兰和LAW,提交书通常获得大部分部分信用,同时缺少至少一项接受标准。 Opus在SWE的高功率分数96.98分,然而却解决了17.65%的SWE任务,LAW在配置上平均得分70.7分,但解决率只有2.9%。

blocks.en: The domain-level divergence also changes which systems appear strongest. In SWE, Astra and Sol score between 71 and 79 in every configuration but resolve no SWE task except Astra at low effort, whereas Opus configurations resolve up to 29.41%. Sonnet at max effort ranks fifteenth by Overall Score but fourth by Overall Resolved, and it attains the highest resolved rate in CDN despite a CDN score below that of two Opus configurations. Conversely, Sol at max effort leads OPS by continuous score with 72.97 but resolves 22.22% of OPS tasks, below the 27.78% of Astra at high effort and Doubao. Reporting both measures therefore distinguishes systems that make broad partial progress from those that more often deliver a fully accepted artifact.
blocks.zh: 域级差异也改变了哪些系统看起来最强。 在 SWE 中, Astra 和 Sol 在每个配置中得分在 71 至 79 之间,但没有解决 SWE 任务,除非 Astra 低功耗,而 Opus 配置则解决率高达 29.41%. Sonnet以最大努力以总得分排名第15位,以总得分排名第4位,尽管CDN的得分低于两个Opus配置,但它在CDN取得了最高的解析率. 相反, 以最大努力率以72.97的连续得分率领导OPS,但解决了22.22%的OPS任务,低于高努力率的Astra和杜宝的27.78%. 因此,报告这两项措施将取得广泛部分进展的制度与通常提供完全接受的文物的制度区分开来。

blocks.en: Continuous scores are considerably higher than resolved rates. Opus at high effort attains the highest Overall Score, 80.21, with 96.98 in SWE and 97.44 in MATH, even though the highest SWE resolved rate is 29.41%. Opus configurations lead seven of the eight domains, at three different effort settings, while Sol at max effort leads OPS with 72.97. OPS separates the two model families most clearly under this measure: every Astra and Sol configuration scores above 62, whereas no Opus or Sonnet configuration exceeds 55.
blocks.zh: 连续的分数大大高于确定的分数。 尽管最高的SWE解析率为29.41%,但高努力率的Opus取得了最高的总得分,80.21分,其中SWE为96.98分,MATH为97.44分。 Opus配置在8个域中领先7个域,在3个不同的努力设置中,Sol在最大努力中领先OPS以72.97. OPS在这一措施下将两个模型家族分开最为明显:每个Astra和Sol配置得分超过62分,而任何Opus或Sonnet配置都没有超过55分.

blocks.en: Additional tokens yield smaller gains in continuous score than in resolved rate. Sonnet at max effort uses 3.2 × \times the tokens of Sonnet at high effort for a gain of 2.96 points, from 70.15 to 73.11, whereas its resolved rate rises by 7.95 points; Sol at low effort comes within 1.20 points of its xhigh configuration while using 54% of the tokens. Additional tokens therefore contribute more to completing tasks fully than to partial progress. With respect to cost, Sol at low effort scores 76.32 at $3.61 per task and Opus at high effort scores 80.21 at $6.66, whereas Astra at xhigh effort scores 77.69 at $29.26.
blocks.zh: 附加标志在连续得分方面的收益比已解决的比率要小。 Sonnet在最大努力时使用3.2×x高努力时使用Sonnet的符号,收益为2.96分,从70.15升至73.11,而它的解速率则上升7.95分; Sol在低努力时在x高配置的1.20分以内,同时使用符号的54%. 因此,额外的标志有助于充分完成任务,而不是部分进展。 在成本方面,Sol低劳分76.32分,每任务3.61美元,Opus高劳分80.21分,6.66美元,Astra高劳分77.69分,29.26美元。
